products.name: Figma AI
products.note: Design AI; auto-layout; content generation; design system governance; Adobe acquisition context

profile_text.body:
Figma describes itself as a collaborative canvas where design, code, and AI come together, positioning its platform as a single place for teams to move from initial concept to shipped product. The company's site emphasizes that human teammates and AI agents work within the same shared space, with the stated ability to generate new design directions, refine work, and align across a team simultaneously.

Figma's AI product, tracked under the category of image and graphic design, is called Figma AI and covers capabilities including auto-layout, content generation, and design system governance. The company trades on a public exchange under the ticker FIG and holds the SEC CIK number 0001579878, confirming its status as a public company.
